name: procyon_a
label: Procyon A (alpha CMi, F5 IV-V)
sources: Aufdenberg et al. 2005 (VLTI/VINCI + Mark III): theta_LD 5.404 +/- 0.031 mas; Kervella et al. 2004: 5.448 +/- 0.053
notes: F5 subgiant; the white dwarf companion (4-5 arcsec, 10 mag fainter) is negligible.
Added 2026-11-04 for the C2PU 15 m H-alpha campaign: at 15 m and 656 nm a star is 20 % resolved at 3 mas and reaches the first null at 11 mas.
